text:
I'm sorry, I know it's frustrating when the card has already been closed. Unfortunately, refunds can only go back to the original payment method, never to a different card, even if the original is closed or expired.

Here are your options:

- **Refund to the original card (ending 7712):** Closing a card doesn't usually stop the refund. The bank normally passes it on to your replacement card. Once the refund is issued, expect it within 5-10 business days on a card, or 3-5 business days if the original payment was a digital wallet. For a duplicate charge, the refund is issued within 3 business days of confirmation.
- **Leafy store credit:** This is issued instantly and never expires. You can use it on any future order, but it isn't a refund to a card.

Your bank can tell you whether it will forward the refund from the closed card to your new one. I don't have more detail on how that works at each bank.

Before any refund, we still need to rule out the multi-parcel case. Did you receive order LF-381204 in one package or more than one? Once I know, I can tell you whether this is a duplicate. If you'd like, I can also escalate this to a Support Lead.
